resources.string: Private voice input for your own Starling server
Use the server root, for example https://host:8181, or its /v1/audio/transcriptions route.
Allow HTTP for a trusted private LAN
Only localhost, private IPv4 or IPv6, link-local, or .local hosts are accepted. HTTPS remains the default.
Connection saved. No credentials are stored.
Could not save this connection setting.
Enter the model slug served by this backend.
Use the model slug reported by /v1/models. Starling defaults to parakeet.
No on-device model yet. Download the recommended Parakeet model (553 MB; Wi-Fi recommended), or import a Parakeet TDT GGUF you already have.
Using %1$s, %2$d MB. Recordings transcribe offline on this device, live while you speak.
Installed: %1$s, %2$d MB, not in use. Choose \"%3$s\" above to transcribe with it.
Kept in Starling\'s private storage (not in Downloads or Files). Tap one to use it.
%1$s is removed from this device. Download or import it again to use it later.
The model could not be deleted.
The model could not be selected.
Android Files did not return a model file. Select the GGUF again.
Model imported and selected. On-device transcription is ready.
Downloading the recommended model: %1$d%% (%2$d of %3$d MB). It resumes where it stopped if the connection drops or the app closes.
Download paused. Tap Resume to continue where it stopped.
not enough free memory (the model needs about %1$d MB, %2$d MB are available). Close other apps or import a smaller model.
Ready. Audio is captured as 16 kHz mono PCM and kept privately before transcription.
Recording… tap Stop and transcribe when finished.
Transcribing live; the partial transcript appears below.
Live transcription stopped: %1$s. The recording continues and will be transcribed when you stop.
Transcription failed. The recording is retained; try Retry.
Could not create a private recording file.
Could not finalize the private WAV recording. It was retained for inspection.
Recording stopped at the 2-hour limit. Transcribing the captured audio…
Storage is almost full (%1$d MB free). Free up space on the phone to record.
Storage is low: about %1$d minutes of recording fit before Starling has to stop.
Storage is almost full, so the recording stopped. Everything up to that point is saved; free up space to record again.

Finished recordings are kept losslessly compressed (FLAC): retries send exactly the audio the first transcription did. Nothing is removed unless you set a limit; a limit removes audio only and keeps transcripts, and never touches recordings from the last day, ones still transcribing, or ones that never got a transcript.
Archived recordings (Archive on a recording) follow their own limits. They are kept as FLAC too; a smaller lossy archival format is not available yet.
Could not save the history audio limits.
the %1$s size limit is still exceeded by %2$d MB
Audio removed by your retention policy on %1$s; the transcript is kept.

resources.string: Microphone permission is required to record.
Interrupted; its audio is recovered the next time Starling starts
Transcribing (automatic retries may be in progress)

Recovered after an interruption (%3$s): %1$s of audio saved. The first %2$s had been confirmed on storage; the rest was written but not yet confirmed. Anything after the interruption was not recorded.
This removes the WAV and its raw transcript from this device. This action cannot be undone.
Could not delete the recording files.
Enable the keyboard in Android Settings, then choose it from the keyboard switcher.

Starling also offers an Android speech recognition service for apps that let you choose one. On Pixel phones, the Digital assistant list is a different setting and cannot select Starling for dictation. Use the Starling keyboard above for voice input in any text field.
Its adjusted form could not be saved to Saved recordings.
Transcript inserted, but its adjusted form could not be saved to Saved recordings.
Transcript inserted as dictated: the field did not share its text, so spacing and capitals were not adjusted.
The take was dictated in another field. It is kept in Starling; copy it, or record again for this field.
The take was dictated in another, private field. It is not kept; copy it now or record again.
Transcription failed. Takes in private fields are not kept; record again.
Private text hidden outside its field.
Allow notifications in Starling, so a take that keeps recording in the background can be stopped from there; then tap Record again.
The take keeps recording while the keyboard is hidden.
Transcription failed. The recording remains available in Starling Mobile.
Allow the microphone in Starling, then come back to this field.
Recording live; text follows as you speak.
Transcription failed. The recording is kept in Starling Mobile for retry.
Starling needs microphone permission to listen.
Recording… the on-device model is still loading; live text follows once it is ready.
Listening… the model is still loading. Tap Done when finished.
Recording… loading the on-device model; live text follows once it is ready.
Loading the on-device model… you can already record.
Recordings are still saved; you can pick another model or a server in Starling Mobile — %1$s
The phone\'s GPU driver reported a failure (%1$s). Recordings are still saved; restarting the phone clears it.
Live transcription stopped: %1$s. Transcribing after stop.
Recording into the draft… nothing is inserted until you tap Insert.
Draft ready. Edit it, then Insert.
Draft ready, processed by rules in %1$d ms. Edit it, then Insert.
Draft ready; the rules changed nothing. Edit it, then Insert.
Draft discarded. The recording stays in Starling.
Inserted. This field has no send action, so nothing was pressed.
“literal” at the start: the rest is kept exactly as spoken.
Left out, no text model yet: instruction “%1$s”
Word selected. Delete it, or tap Record and say what replaces it.
Say what replaces the selected word, then tap Stop.
Nothing was replaced: the correction was empty or the draft changed meanwhile.
Only a mode phrase or instruction was said; there is nothing to insert.
Word replaced. Edit more, or Insert.
The last recording is still on its way into the draft.
The field did not accept the text; the draft is kept and nothing was sent.
Not transcribed; the audio stays in Starling for retry. The draft keeps its earlier text.
This mode asks for a text model the phone does not have yet; rules only.
Choose a mode for the next take, or say its phrase at the start.
